title: Christianity as Mystical Fact
author: Rudolf Steiner
description: Christianity as Mystical Fact and the Mysteries of Antiquity by Rudolf Steiner (Das Christentum als mystische Tatsache, 1902), in an early English translation. Based on lectures given in Berlin in 1901-02, it argues that Christianity grew out of the ancient mystery religions while fulfilling and transforming them. Steiner discusses the mysteries and the sages of Greece before Plato, Plato as a mystic, the wisdom of the mysteries and myth, the Egyptian mystery wisdom, the Gospels as accounts of initiation, the raising of Lazarus as an initiation, the Apocalypse of John, Jesus and his historical background, the nature of Christianity, Christianity and pagan wisdom, and Augustine and the Church. The central thesis is that what was enacted in secret in the mysteries became a historical event, open to all, in the life, death and resurrection of Christ. It is a key text of esoteric Christianity.
